home.highlightsSubtitle: From kindergarten to adult high school diplomas, from Anglia certifications to holistic therapy — AGI is a complete education ecosystem.
home.why1Text: Open-enrollment micro-school welcoming students of all backgrounds and learning needs, with IEP support and small multi-grade classrooms.
home.why2Text: The main headquarters of Anglia Examinations of England in Morocco — step-by-step CEFR-aligned English certification since 1993.
home.why3Text: All-inclusive packages: books, exams, insurance and dual USA–Morocco enrollment, with clear monthly payment plans for working families.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to Join the AGI Family?
home.ctaSubtitle: Discover our diverse American education — book a free consultation or visit us in Agadir.

programs.k12Desc: Full American curriculum from Kindergarten to Grade 12 in a nurturing micro-school setting.

programs.adultDesc: Fast-track American high school diploma for learners aged 16 and above.
programs.specialDesc: Individualized Education Plans, ADHD coaching, play therapy and i-Heart counselling.
programs.podsDesc: Small-group learning and online tutoring led by certified teacherpreneurs.
